registryBasis: The City of Poway publishes PowGIS and GeoHUB as local public mapping/data services. The PowGIS APN Basemap is an official public parcel polygon layer; its metadata attributes parcel maintenance to SanGIS using County Assessor/Recorder/County Clerk source data. This is local GIS/service evidence, not merely general national-agency prose.

officialSources.observation: City page says PowGIS searches by address, parcel number, or street intersection and displays parcel property reports, and identifies the City GeoHUB for GIS data/apps.
officialSources.scope: City of Poway public GIS entry points.

officialSources.observation: Current ArcGIS layer metadata identifies APN Basemap, polygon geometry, public query formats, native source spatial reference 102646/latestWkid 2230, and parcel identity concepts APN/PARCELID. Metadata warns the layer may lag official Assessor Parcel Maps and is not survey-grade.
officialSources.scope: SanGIS parcel layer published through the City PowGIS service.

officialSources.observation: Indexed ArcGIS metadata identifies the City PowHUB Parcel Info polygon layer, APN field, native OBJECTID identity, and EPSG:102646/2230 service spatial reference.
officialSources.scope: City of Poway PowHUB landbase parcel layer.

requests.outcome: Official City page fetched; PowGIS and GeoHUB links and parcel-map scope were confirmed.

First-party indexed REST metadata was inspected. It returned polygon geometry, native layer CRS EPSG:102646/latestWkid 2230, public GeoJSON support, and source fields including OBJECTID, APN, and Shape. A direct shell request was also attempted but timed out after 8 seconds (HTTP 000).

Bounded anonymous exact-point query was attempted with the unchanged WUP point and safe identity fields only. Direct shell request timed out after 8 seconds (HTTP 000); the web fetch tool refused the query endpoint. No geometry or parcel identity was treated as returned, and no sample GeoJSON was retained.

First-party indexed REST metadata was inspected for the City PowHUB Parcel Info polygon layer; it exposed native OBJECTID/APN schema and EPSG:102646/2230 metadata. No feature query was retained after the PowGIS query timeout and no geometry response was available.

source: City of Poway PowGIS / PowHUB ArcGIS REST parcel layers; underlying parcel data described as SanGIS using County ARCC source data

runtimeReadinessReason: A real local public parcel service is evidenced, but the anonymous feature query did not produce a retained geometry response. A serial reviewer must independently qualify route, identifier mapping, CRS handling, and safe-field behavior. This packet is not source integration or admission.
remainingUncertainty: The local PowGIS/PowHUB service and parcel-layer schema are evidenced, but exact-point response availability, current feature-query behavior, citywide completeness, update cadence, and adapter qualification remain unverified. The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted. A timeout or unusable query endpoint is not evidence of citywide absence. No credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, owner/address data, or unsafe fields were used.
